content: Vbvrikunamv ngonugv lvkobv Pwknvyarnv gvlo kudungkua ribam kolo, ngonu nonua dinchibv mindunv, yvvdw Pwknvyarnv gv anyubv aya jinam a naarwk sudunv hv ung anyung kaamanvgobv rimu mabvka.

content.text: “Vdwlo nonua ngoogv kaiyabv aya kaatamdw hv aatokudw,

content: Tvriato! Siinv Pwknvyarnv gvlo kaibv aya nga naarwk sidw hv; silugv alu si ringlinbalindw alu hv!
Ngonu yvvnyika ngonugv kudungkua rikulo alvmanv go kaapa mosu mvngma, vkvlvgabv ngonu akonvgv lamtvlo adwkaku go mvlwk rilwk madubv vla rikw dunv.
Vmabvya, ngonugv rinam mvnwnglo ngonu Pwknvyarnv gv pakbu gubv ngonu kaatam sila adwkaku ha, hirukaya nga, okv rinyu manam dvdv nga hinla saktv sidula ridungdunv.
Ngonua dvngtoku, patwklo tumtoku, okv nyitwng ngv goyum nyato; ngonua kudungkua rilv yamuto okv dvnam guma jeka yupnam guka paamabv ripvkunv.
Darwknv Dow lokv, ngonugv jvjvnv paknam lokv; ngonugv darwk kolokv, chinampaanam a, saktv nga, okv aya nga Pwknvyarnv gv pakbu gubv kaatamsula ripvkunv,
ngonugv jvjvnv doin lokv, okv Pwknvyarnv gv jwkrw lokv. Ngonu gvlo darwkchongjor hv yidu gubvrila baanyi gubv ridu, mvmisinv dubv okv atubongv mvngging sunvdubv.
Nyi kvgonv ngonua mvngdvto okv kvgonv ngonua minying toku; ngonua miyakayato okv hartvto. Ngonua mvvnvrunv gubv minyato vbvritola ngonu jvjv nga mintoku.
Chimpa manam aingbv rito, vbvritola ngonuv mvnwng gv chinkunam; ngonu sikunv aingbv rito, vbvritola, nonuv kaadu, ngonu turla svngdu. Mvrit kubvka, ngonua mvki kuma;

mvngdwk dubv mvku bvka, ngonu lokia mvngpu toku; ngonua heemanv aingbv kaato, vbvritola ngonu nyi achialvgo nyitv dubv mvdu; ngonu oguguka kaamanv aingbv kaato, vbvritola ngonu jvjvbv ogumvnwng nga doogvdu.
Aya sinam ajin vdwa Korint lo doonv! Ngonu nonua minkak milak jipv kunv; ngonu haapok sin a kokdariaka jipv kunv.
Nonugv lvgabv ngonugv haapok ka mvtum nvngv ngonuma; nonunogv haapok vdwa ngonugv lvgabv nonu mvtum yato.
Ngo vjak nonua ngoogv kuu jvbv mindu: nonugv lvgabv ngonugv mvngnam apiabv nonuka mvngla ngonua kaatam tvkuka. Nonugv haapok a kokdariaka tvkuka!
Pwknvyarnvnyi chimanv vdwa nyokku nvnga gamrwnam

Mvngjwng manv vdwa karingchingbv lvkobv kudungkua ribam dubv rikw mabvka, ogulvgavbolo hv rilamarung sv-ngv. Jvjv nvngvla jvjv manv ngv oguaingbv akin nyudubv? Pua ngvla kanv ngv oguaingbv akin gubv doobam nyudubv?
Oguaingbv Kristo la Uyudvbv ngv tolwk minsu ladubv? Mvngjwngnv ako mvngjwng manv anga akin namv oguv?
Pwknvyarnvnyi kumging naam hv oguaingbv Pwknvyarnvnyi chima nvgv kumnam morti vdwa akin nyudubv? Ogulvgavbolo ngonuv turnv Pwknvyarnv gv kumging naam mv! Pwknvyarnv atubongv vbv mintoku:

content.text: “Ngo ngoogv naam a ngoogv nyi vdwa lvkobv mvre
okv bunu ngoogv nyi bv rireku.”
okv nonu atubongv bunu vdwa akusubv resu daksu tokuka.
okv nonuno ngoogv umv okv uu vdwbv rireku.”
